title: The Best Black Friday Mac Deals Still Available
content:
Black Friday is here, and we're tracking some of the year's best prices on Apple's Mac lineup today. This includes the new M6 MacBook Pro, MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR, MacBook Neo, MacBook Air, and more.

Note: MacRumors is an affiliate partner with some of these vendors. When you click a link and make a purchase, we may receive a small payment, which helps us keep the site running.

M6 MacBook Pro



Starting with the cheaper model, Amazon now has the entry-level 14-inch M6 MacBook Pro (16GB RAM/1TB) for the new all-time low price of $1,749.00, down from $1,999.00. This beats the deal we tracked earlier in the week by about $30. You can get this computer, plus the models with upgraded 24GB and 32GB of RAM, on sale for Black Friday.

$250 OFF
14-inch M6 MacBook Pro for $1,749.00
  • 14-inch 16GB RAM/1TB - $1,749.00, down from $1,999.00

  • 14-inch 24GB RAM/1TB - $1,949.00, down from $2,199.00

  • 14-inch 32GB RAM/1TB - $2,149.00, down from $2,399.00

MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR



Moving to the 16-inch MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display, Amazon has up to $327 off these models for Black Friday. Prices start at $3,099.00 for the 24GB RAM/1TB model, which is a $300 discount on the computer, coming in at $99 steeper than the previous low price. The overall biggest discount is on the 16-inch model with 48GB RAM/2TB, on sale for $5,072.00, down from $5,399.00, a big $327 discount.

$300 OFF
16-inch MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR for $3,099.00
  • 16-inch 24GB RAM/1TB - $3,099.00, down from $3,399.00

  • 16-inch 48GB RAM/1TB - $3,749.00, down from $3,999.00

  • 16-inch 36GB RAM/2TB - $4,509.00, down from $4,799.00

  • 16-inch 48GB RAM/2TB - $5,072.00, down from $5,399.00

M5 MacBook Air



Prices now start at $999.99 for the 512GB 13-inch M5 MacBook Air. This is a $299 discount on the computer, and you'll also find $399 off both 1TB 13-inch M5 MacBook Air models.

$299 OFF
13-inch M5 MacBook Air (16GB/512GB) for $999.99

$399 OFF
13-inch M5 MacBook Air (16GB/1TB) for $1,199.99

$399 OFF
13-inch M5 MacBook Air (24GB/1TB) for $1,399.99


For the 15-inch M5 MacBook Air models, prices start with the 16GB/512GB model for $1,199.00, down from $1,499.00. You can also get the 16GB/1TB model for $1,399.99, down from $1,799.00, which is a $399 markdown and another all-time low price for Black Friday.

$300 OFF
15-inch M5 MacBook Air (16GB/512GB) for $1,199.00

$399 OFF
15-inch M5 MacBook Air (16GB/1TB) for $1,399.99

$399 OFF
15-inch M5 MacBook Air (24GB/1TB) for $1,599.99

MacBook Neo



Amazon has introduced big $99 discounts across the entire MacBook Neo lineup for Black Friday, with prices starting at $599.99 for the 256GB MacBook Neo, down from $699.00. All four colors are available at these prices for both models.

$99 OFF
MacBook Neo (256GB) for $599.99

$99 OFF
MacBook Neo (512GB) for $699.99


You can also get the 512GB MacBook Neo with Touch ID on sale for $699.99, another $99 discount. Both of these match the best prices we've seen since Apple's price increases over the summer.

Mac mini



Apple's new Mac mini has had one of the most consistent discounts over the past few weeks, and these $119-$150 markdowns have continued into Black Friday season. Prices start at $779.00 for the entry-level model, and currently include every M6 model, plus the M5 Pro model.

$120 OFF
M6 Mac mini 16GB/256GB for $779.00

$150 OFF
M6 Mac mini 16GB/512GB for $949.00

$149 OFF
M6 Mac mini 24GB/512GB for $1,149.99

$150 OFF
M5 Pro Mac mini 24GB/512GB for $1,549.00

Mac Studio



Additionally, one of the best Black Friday deals is on the M5 Max Mac Studio with 36GB RAM and a 512GB SSD, on sale for $2,299.00, down from $2,499.00.

$200 OFF
M5 Max Mac Studio 36GB/512GB for $2,299.00

Studio Display



Amazon this week introduced the first discounts on the Apple Studio Display in months, with $200 off every model of the 2026 display, plus a $300 discount on the Studio Display XDR as well.

$200 OFF
Apple Studio Display for $1,399.00


Prices start at $1,399.00 for the Standard Glass Studio Display with Tilt-Adjustable Stand, down from $1,599.00. Across the board, these are all some of the best discounts we've ever seen on the Studio Display.

Studio Display
  • Standard Glass with VESA Mount - $1,399.00, down from $1,599.00

  • Standard Glass with Tilt-Adjustable Stand - $1,399.00, down from $1,599.00

  • Standard Glass with Tilt- and Height-Adjustable Stand - $1,799.00, down from $1,999.00

  • Nano-texture Glass with VESA Mount - $1,699.00, down from $1,899.00

  • Nano-texture Glass with Tilt- and Height-Adjustable Stand - $2,099.00, down from $2,299.00

Studio Display XDR
  • Nano-texture Glass with VESA Mount - $2,899.00, down from $3,199.00
